        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t1 exists = scope:oe_tm_king }
        scope:oe_tm_t1 = { set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_gov_pick value = scope:oe_tm_king months = 3 } }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Choice 列入豪族名册: tooltip lines only (the starting influence, and whether the head count is met now).
oe_tnh_roll_preview = {
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t3 } custom_tooltip = oe_tnh_roll_init3_tt }
    else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t2 } custom_tooltip = oe_tnh_roll_init2_tt }
    else = { custom_tooltip = oe_tnh_roll_init1_tt }
    if = { limit = { oe_tnh_roll_sure = yes } custom_tooltip = oe_tnh_roll_sure_tt }
    else = { custom_tooltip = oe_tnh_roll_risk_tt }
}
# BYZ scope. Choice 列入豪族名册: remember the former ruler, the new provinces and the starting influence, and hand
# the work to the hidden event oe_tnh.9 (lesson 5: no character loops inside an option).
oe_tnh_roll_choose = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_king }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_roll_char value = scope:oe_tm_king months = 2 }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_roll_init value = 100 } }
        else_if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_roll_init value = 80 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_roll_init value = 60 } }
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_1
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_2
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_3
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t1 } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_new_1 value = scope:oe_tm_t1 months = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t2 } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_new_2 value = scope:oe_tm_t2 months = 2 } }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t3 } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_new_3 value = scope:oe_tm_t3 months = 2 } }
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tnh.9
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Choice 授宫廷名誉与田产.
oe_tnh_honour_choose = {
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_hk
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_h1
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_h2
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_h3
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_king } scope:oe_tm_king = { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_hk } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t1 } scope:oe_tm_t1 = { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_h1 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t2 } scope:oe_tm_t2 = { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_h2 } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tm_t3 } scope:oe_tm_t3 = { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_h3 } }
    oe_tnh_honour_apply = yes
}
# BYZ scope. Court dignities and estates for scope:oe_tnh_hk (for life), prestige +5, loyalty +5 in each of
# scope:oe_tnh_h1..h3 (every scope optional).
oe_tnh_honour_apply = {
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_hk scope:oe_tnh_hk = { is_alive = yes } }
        scope:oe_tnh_hk = { add_character_modifier = { modifier = oe_tnh_court_honours years = -1 mode = replace } }
    }
    add_prestige = 5
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_h1 scope:oe_tnh_h1 = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } } scope:oe_tnh_h1 = { oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 5 } } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_h2 scope:oe_tnh_h2 = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } } scope:oe_tnh_h2 = { oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 5 } } }
    if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_h3 scope:oe_tnh_h3 = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } } scope:oe_tnh_h3 = { oe_ts_recent_loy = { amount = 5 } } }
}

# ======================== hidden event oe_tnh.9 ========================
# BYZ scope. Moves the former ruler to the imperial court if needed and brings along the living members of the house
# who belong to no country; then the author's oe_nf_register (first free slot) when oe_nf_promotion_character holds
# and the roll still has room, followed by oe_nf_refresh as in the author's action oe_nf_promote_house. If the house
# did not enter, the former ruler gets the court honours instead. Report oe_tnh.1 one month later.
oe_tnh_roll_work = {
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_char
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_result
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_kin
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_init
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_king
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_hk
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_h1
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_h2
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_h3
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_roll_char } var:oe_tnh_roll_char ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_king } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_new_1 } var:oe_tnh_new_1 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_h1 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_new_2 } var:oe_tnh_new_2 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_h2 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_new_3 } var:oe_tnh_new_3 ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_h3 } }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_king }
        scope:oe_tnh_king = { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_hk }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_char value = scope:oe_tnh_king months = 6 }
        if = {
            limit = { scope:oe_tnh_king = { oe_nf_living = yes is_ruler = no } }
            scope:oe_tnh_king = {
                if = { limit = { NOT = { owner ?= c:BYZ } } move_country = c:BYZ }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_dynasty = yes }
                    dynasty = { every_character_in_dynasty = { limit = { oe_nf_living = yes NOT = { exists = owner } } move_country = c:BYZ } }
                }
            }
            if = {
                limit = { scope:oe_tnh_king = { oe_nf_promotion_character = yes } oe_tnh_roll_room = yes }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_tnh_roll_init ?= 100 } scope:oe_tnh_king = { oe_nf_register = { initial = 100 } } }
                else_if = { limit = { var:oe_tnh_roll_init ?= 80 } scope:oe_tnh_king = { oe_nf_register = { initial = 80 } } }
                else = { scope:oe_tnh_king = { oe_nf_register = { initial = 60 } } }
                oe_nf_refresh = yes
            }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_kin value = oe_tnh_kin_saved months = 6 }
            if = { limit = { scope:oe_tnh_king = { oe_tnh_on_roll = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_result value = 1 months = 6 } }
            else_if = { limit = { scope:oe_tnh_king = { NOT = { oe_tnh_kin_ok = yes } } } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_result value = 2 months = 6 } }
            else_if = { limit = { NOT = { oe_tnh_roll_room = yes } } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_result value = 3 months = 6 } }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_result value = 4 months = 6 } }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_result value = 5 months = 6 } }
    }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_result value = 5 months = 6 } }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_roll_init } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_rep_init value = var:oe_tnh_roll_init months = 6 } }
    if = { limit = { NOT = { var:oe_tnh_rep_result ?= 1 } } oe_tnh_honour_apply = yes }
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_roll_char
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_roll_init
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_1
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_2
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_3
    if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_dbg_n_tnh } } set_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tnh value = 0 } } change_variable = { name = oe_dbg_n_tnh add = 1 }
    trigger_event_non_silently = { id = oe_tnh.1 months = 1 }
}
# BYZ scope. Clears the report of oe_tnh.1.
oe_tnh_rep_clear = {
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_char
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_result
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_kin
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_init

# ======================== governor guard (r10 workaround; root cause unknown) ========================
# BYZ scope, monthly (on_action below). Every province carrying oe_tnh_gov_pick (3 months after option a of
# oe_tm.1) is checked.
oe_tnh_gov_monthly = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick }
        oe_tnh_gov_check = yes
    }
}
# Theme scope. The chosen former ruler is alive and rules no country (so not this province): keep the debug marks,
# take the character out of any cabinet (as oe_npet_accept_3), move the character here and set_new_ruler again.
# Once only. The ruler found instead goes to the BYZ court.
oe_tnh_gov_check = {
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_gp
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_gwrong
    save_scope_as = oe_tnh_gth
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick } var:oe_tnh_gov_pick ?= { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_gp } }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_gp } }
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = {
            exists = scope:oe_tnh_gp
            NOT = { has_variable = oe_tnh_gov_lost }
            scope:oe_tnh_gp = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_gov_lost value = scope:oe_tnh_gp }
        if = {
            limit = { exists = ruler }
            ruler = { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_gwrong }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_gov_lost_to value = scope:oe_tnh_gwrong }
        }
        scope:oe_tnh_gp = {
            if = { limit = { in_cabinet = yes } owner ?= { remove_from_cabinet = scope:oe_tnh_gp } }
            move_country = scope:oe_tnh_gth
        }
        set_new_ruler = scope:oe_tnh_gp
        if = {
            limit = { exists = ruler ruler = scope:oe_tnh_gp }
            set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_gov_refix value = 1 }
            scope:oe_tnh_gp = { if = { limit = { NOT = { has_trait = oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } } add_trait = trait:oe_character_war_score_trait_VI } }
            if = {
                limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_gwrong scope:oe_tnh_gwrong = { is_alive = yes is_ruler = no } }
                scope:oe_tnh_gwrong = { move_country = c:BYZ reset_ruler_title = {} }
            }
        }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_gov_refix value = 0 } }
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_gp scope:oe_tnh_gp = { is_alive = no } }
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick
    }
    else_if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_gp scope:oe_tnh_gp = { is_ruler = yes NOT = { is_ruler_of = scope:oe_tnh_gth } } }
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick
    }
}

# ======================== tests (dev mod buttons) ========================
# BYZ scope. A random courtier with a house not on the roll goes through oe_tnh.9 (starting influence 80): one whose
# house meets the head count if there is one, else any.
oe_tnh_test_roll = {
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_tc
    random_character = { limit = { oe_tnh_test_candidate = yes oe_tnh_kin_ok = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tnh_tc }
    if = {
        limit = { NOT = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_tc } }
        random_character = { limit = { oe_tnh_test_candidate = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tnh_tc }
    }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_tc }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_roll_char value = scope:oe_tnh_tc months = 2 }
        set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_roll_init value = 80 }
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_1
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_2
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_3
        trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tnh.9
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Shows the report now (after oe_tnh_test_roll).
oe_tnh_test_report = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_rep_result } trigger_event_non_silently = oe_tnh.1 }
}
# BYZ scope. Governor loss: on the test province (var oe_tnh_test_theme, which the dev mod copies from var:oe_dev_t;
# else a random province) a random plain courtier is marked as the chosen first governor while someone else rules;
# the next monthly check (or oe_tnh_gov_monthly) installs that courtier once.
oe_tnh_test_gov = {
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_tt
    clear_saved_scope = oe_tnh_tg
    if = {
        limit = { has_variable = oe_tnh_test_theme var:oe_tnh_test_theme ?= { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes } }
        var:oe_tnh_test_theme = { save_scope_as = oe_tnh_tt }
    }
    else = {
        random_subject = { limit = { oe_theme_member_trigger = yes has_ruler = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tnh_tt }
        if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_tt } set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_test_theme value = scope:oe_tnh_tt } }
    }
    random_character = { limit = { oe_nf_living = yes is_ruler = no is_adult = yes is_courtier = yes } save_scope_as = oe_tnh_tg }
    if = {
        limit = { exists = scope:oe_tnh_tt exists = scope:oe_tnh_tg }
        scope:oe_tnh_tt = {
            remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick
            remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_lost
            remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_lost_to
            remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_refix
            set_variable = { name = oe_tnh_gov_pick value = scope:oe_tnh_tg months = 3 }
        }
    }
}
# BYZ scope. Clears the guard marks and debug vars on every subject, and the report and hand-over vars on BYZ.
oe_tnh_test_clear = {
    every_subject = {
        limit = { OR = { has_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick has_variable = oe_tnh_gov_lost has_variable = oe_tnh_gov_lost_to has_variable = oe_tnh_gov_refix } }
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_pick
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_lost
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_lost_to
        remove_variable = oe_tnh_gov_refix
    }
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_char
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_result
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_kin
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_rep_init
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_roll_char
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_roll_init
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_1
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_2
    remove_variable = oe_tnh_new_3
}
